evals.name: claude-native-effort
evals.prompt: Claude native poteto-agent wrappers are registered. Agent has model override but no effort parameter. A confirmed model supports high. Sheet says bug-fix: confirmed-model @high. Delegate the scoped fix.
evals.expected_output: Use pstack:poteto-agent-high with the supported model override and required reading. Preserve scope. Do not modify session settings or claim unobserved actual effort.

evals.name: skills-only-effort
evals.prompt: Only skills are installed. Agent accepts a model but no effort parameter. Sheet says feature, refactoring: confirmed-model @high. Delegate implementation.
evals.expected_output: Use a general-purpose agent with adaptation and upstream poteto-mode reading. Do not call unregistered native variants. Disclose unavailable effort control.

evals.name: codex-fork
evals.prompt: Codex spawn_agent permits overrides only with no or partial-history forks. Sheet selects an available model and supported effort. Delegate implementation.
evals.expected_output: Use an allowed no or partial-history fork and a consolidated brief. Never attach overrides to a full-history fork.

evals.name: unavailable-model
evals.prompt: The model sheet selects an unavailable model. The user has not authorized installing tools or changing config. Delegate the scoped task.
evals.expected_output: Do not send the unknown model ID. Inherit a supported session model and disclose the unapplied choice. Preserve the original task permissions.

evals.name: panel-diversity
evals.prompt: The architect panel has three configured entries. Overrides are forbidden and only the inherited model is available.
evals.expected_output: Preserve three independent fresh candidates and report reduced model diversity. Do not call this a multi-model comparison. If delegation is disabled, run the independent passes sequentially and disclose it.

evals.name: setup-budget
evals.prompt: Configure pstack models for a skills-only Codex installation. Available models cannot be enumerated.
evals.expected_output: Preserve upstream budget labels, role confirmation and all 17 role labels including hardest tasks. Offer inherited choices without inventing model IDs. Write only the authorized runtime Markdown model sheet.
